# Blue-IQ

> Blue-IQ is a document AI platform. Its products turn business documents — contracts, invoices, resumes, licences and agreements — into structured, confidence-scored data. Every product runs on Sonar, Blue-IQ's AI, which scores every extracted field and routes anything uncertain to a person instead of guessing.

## Products
- [Capture](https://www.parsinglab.blue-iq.ai/): turns incoming documents into clean, structured data.
- [Spend](https://blue-iq.ai/products#spend): keeps invoices in line with what was agreed.
- [Govern](https://govern.blue-iq.ai/): keeps contracts and obligations in view.
- [Campus and Workforce editions](https://blue-iq.ai/products#editions): the products packaged for higher education, and for staffing and healthcare.

## Pages
- [Sonar, the platform](https://blue-iq.ai/platform): how the AI reads, scores, flags, drafts and answers.
- [Trust Center](https://blue-iq.ai/trust): security controls, data handling, compliance status.
- [Products](https://blue-iq.ai/products)
- [Solutions by industry](https://blue-iq.ai/solutions): [IT](https://blue-iq.ai/solutions/it), [education](https://blue-iq.ai/solutions/education), [workforce](https://blue-iq.ai/solutions/workforce), [healthcare staffing](https://blue-iq.ai/solutions/healthcare), [legal](https://blue-iq.ai/solutions/legal), [procurement](https://blue-iq.ai/solutions/procurement); custom builds, migrations, integrations.
- [Developer guide](https://blue-iq.ai/resources): REST API, signed webhooks, supported formats, confidence scores.
- [About](https://blue-iq.ai/about)
- [Contact](https://blue-iq.ai/contact)

## Facts
- Up to 200 documents per API call; sub-second median read.
- Every field returned with its own confidence score.
- Handling aligned to SOC 2, HIPAA and GDPR.
